name: Deadlock
notes: Named as a Steam game without a profile is, so that its logs and its Windows environment stay where they were before it had one. Source 2, Direct3D 11. On a MacBook Air M3 (1920x1243 points) the game's borderless window at the display's size ran its first screen at 67 frames a second with 26 ms from a frame's start to the end of its GPU work; a 1440x932 picture at 104 and 16 ms, a 1280x829 one at 118 and 15 ms, while half the rendered pixels at the full size gave 83 and the lowest quality settings nothing more: what the game does at the picture's size is most of a frame (docs/perf/latency.md, 'Deadlock on the M3'). renderPixels is 1440x932, the largest picture measured at 100: on the chips with the base GPU the game is shown a screen of about that many pixels and the picture is scaled up to fill the display (Wine patch 0017). Measured on the M3 only; the M1 and M2 have a slower GPU and the M4's is about a fifth faster. The Pro and Max chips are left at the display's size, unmeasured.
